name: tka-composer-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions for TKA Composer

scripts.copy-data: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.join(__dirname, 'data'); const dest = path.join(__dirname, 'lib', 'data'); if (!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.mkdirSync(dest, {recursive: true}); fs.readdirSync(src).forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, f), path.join(dest, f)));"
scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
